arrested: Arrested. Fined {{fine}} and your contraband was taken.
customers-empty: No one is waiting. Customers come by once you have a market stall.
downed: You are down. Waking at the meadow…
err-bad-amount: That is not a valid amount.
err-bad-terrain: You can only build on open grass.
err-contraband: No stall will buy that. Hustle it on the street.
err-missing: You do not have enough of that.
err-no-plot: Seeds need a farm plot first.
err-no-stall: Build a market stall to sell things.
err-no-weapon: Buy that gun and equip it first.
err-unknown-player: You are not in this world yet.
err-unknown-recipe: You do not know that recipe.
gun-keys: F fire in the direction you face · R reload
gun-law: Armed or firing, you are shot at. Unarmed, you are arrested.
heat-calm: Street deals pay well and draw attention. Heat fades slowly.
heat-wanted: The police are looking for you. Armed, they shoot; unarmed, they arrest.
hint-walk: WASD move · Q/E turn · Space use · V plan view
hustle-hint: Sold on the street at ×{{markup}}; you gain heat
officer-down: Officer down. Heat is way up. +{{drop}}
pantry-empty: Nothing yet — plant something and wait for it to ripen.
respawned: You came to at the meadow. Fined {{fine}}.
street-empty: Nothing to sell. Brew something in a kitchen.
